violation_type.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages
violation_type.typical_finding: Caregivers did not provide  the correct ages of the children they were caring for when asked.

finding_variants.text: Caregivers did not provide  the correct ages of the children they were caring for when asked.
A caregiver did not know the ages of the children in care.
